headline: A Russian FPV drone operator struck a light anti-drone air defense system, identified as MAAWLR, operated by the Armed Forces of Ukraine and produced by the American company Sierra Nevada Corp. The MAAWLR system is mounted on a pickup truck chassis and is equipped with an electro-optical targeting system for autonomous target detection, while also being capable of receiving external target designation from radar assets. It can use a range of missiles, including AIM-9M, AIM-132 ASRAAM, AIM-120 AMRAAM, IRIS-T, R-27, and APKWS II. Depending on the munition used, the system is assessed to be capable of engaging drones at ranges of approximately 6–15 km.

headline: Iran's FM Spokesperson, Esmail Baghaei: The U.S. ruling establishment has never shown any sincerity in its behavior toward the Iranian nation. Iran, while having ample reason for this suspicion, entered the diplomatic process in good faith and signed the memorandum of understanding to end the imposed war. Iranians know that the enemy's animosity will not end with the signing of a single agreement, and they will take every step with vigilance, bearing in mind the experiences of the past five decades, especially the developments of the last year and a half. The contradictory statements by U.S. officials regarding the memorandum of understanding to end the imposed war will do nothing to reduce the accumulated distrust of Iranians and will merely serve as a reminder of past breaches of faith. The U.S. ruling establishment must bear in mind that the principle of "commitment for commitment" requires the fulfillment of reciprocal obligations and the avoidance of interpretations that are entirely at odds with the explicit wording of the memorandum of understanding text.
